The step's declared checker (check_queues.py) exits 0 with two documented no-email WARNs; check-outputs ok. Built, not blocked.
confidence_rationale: Step 10 MEDIUM: a documented skill default stood in for two unanswered settings (doesIncludeBosses=true on the three Groups; doesSendEmailToMembers=false read off the Q88 notification matrix), and one cited skill's checker (check_data_skew_and_sharing_performance.py) exits 1 on three INFO findings that cannot be fixed inside this step's declared outputs. process_observations.observation: The cited queue skill's version table carries per-element API floors, which caught doesIncludeBosses (Queue, 67.0+) before it was written into a 62.0 manifest.
check_queues.py now recurses and reads the real element names, so the step's first-ever declared run of it needed no argument-form workaround and produced exactly the findings the plan predicted.

The Billing queue's email address is billing@acme.example, which requirement.md also names as the finance Email-to-Case intake address, so a queue-assignment notification is delivered to an address Email-to-Case reads.
All three Groups deploy empty because group membership is GroupMember data, so a green deploy of this step produces three work pools with nobody in them until the post-deploy load runs.

The plan orders M3-S05's queueRoutingConfig after M2-S04, while the cited reference says to deploy the routing configuration before the queue, so Tier_1_General ships without its Omni-Channel link and needs a second pass.

Q88 accepts 'a shared mailbox' for Tier 2 but names no address, so Tier_2_Engineering ships with no email element and the step's own acceptance-test description - written from a fixture in which it had one - predicts one WARN where the checker now emits two.

Q29's answer names role and public group as the membership sources, but no role developer name exists in the requirement, in any of the 97 clarifications, or in an upstream artefact, so the role half of the answer could not be written.

The step's type is access while standards/build-orchestration.md section 4 files Queue metadata under routing; both types are owned by this agent in design-only mode, so the build proceeded, but the type and the artefact column disagree.
The step's five acceptance tests, including the four manual ones, belong to the tester rather than to this agent.
